about-text: Born in Vietnam, I moved to Singapore in 2015 to study under scholarships. Despite my dream of becoming an architect when I was young, I developed interest in programming during my secondary school which led to my pursuit of a computer science degree in Singapore University of Technology and Design. I am now a Backend Developer at Woven By Toyota in Tokyo but sometimes I still find time to do small sketches of things and people that I observe in my daily life.
